scope: One isolated Kubernetes v1.36.1 API server with a blocking Metadata audit policy. Three exact-name, case-owned ConfigMap reads use the same scoped ServiceAccount via Kubernetes impersonation. The ordinary and role-denied reads produce completed metadata events. An explicitly omitted successful read produces no event. A local detector evaluates only the collected metadata and correlates one 403 with the effective identity and recorded source path. Forwarded addresses remain context. A single inert invalid bearer value is sent directly to this disposable API server and must produce a 401 audit event with no authenticated identity. Production collection, origin verification and alert delivery need separate evidence.
